label: Трамвай
description: Twelve-mission case drill for трамвай (tram, streetcar) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form трамвай ends in -й and takes no added ending as the subject. As the doer of едет, it stands in the nominative, the naming form.

missions.phrase: Я вышел из трамвая на углу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The -й is replaced by the soft genitive ending -я, giving трамвая. The preposition из, marking motion out of, governs the genitive, and -й stems take -я rather than -а.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. The -й gives way to the dative ending -ю, producing трамваю. The preposition к, marking motion toward, governs the dative, where -й stems take -ю.
Strategic focus: Accusative singular. Because трамвай is inanimate, its accusative equals the nominative and the form stays трамвай. It serves as the direct object of ждали, the thing awaited.

missions.phrase: Я обычно езжу трамваем на работу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The -й takes the instrumental ending -ем, giving трамваем. The instrumental of means names the vehicle used, and since the ending is unstressed it is written -ем.

Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The -й is replaced by the prepositional ending -е, giving трамвае. The preposition в, marking location, governs the prepositional, and -й stems take the -е ending.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The -й stem forms the plural in -и, so трамвай becomes трамваи. As the subjects of ходят, they appear in the nominative plural, the listing form.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The -й stem takes the genitive plural ending -ев, giving трамваев. The phrase нет of absence governs the genitive, and -й stems select -ев rather than the hard -ов.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. The dative plural ending -ям attaches to the -й stem, giving трамваям. The dative marks the recipients for which the rails were bought.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. Since трамвай is inanimate, the accusative plural matches the nominative plural, so the form stays трамваи. They function as direct objects of ремонтирует.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The instrumental plural ending -ями attaches to the -й stem, giving трамваями. The instrumental names what the street is filled with, and the soft stem selects -ями over -ами.

Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The prepositional plural ending -ях attaches to the -й stem, giving трамваях. The preposition в, marking location, governs the prepositional, and the soft stem gives -ях rather than -ах.
